simple.meaning: כְּסִיל (Kᵉçîyl) is a Hebrew word meaning “any notable constellation ; specifically Orion (as if a burly one).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: any notable constellation ; specifically Orion (as if a burly one)
definitions.full: H3685. Kesil II. כְּסִיל noun masculine Orion (relation to above √ obscure); — Amos 5:8 ; Job 9:9 ; also כ ׳משְׁכוֺת תְּפַתֵּחַ 38:31 the cords of Orion wilt ( canst ) thou let out ? (apparently some mythological allusion, see Di Che, to giant bound in skies; compare Homer ' Ωρίωνα δοκεύει , and σθέηος Ὠρίωνος ); both times associated with the Pleiades; suffix כְּסִילֵיהֶם their Orions Isa 13:10 , Orion and other constellations of the same brilliancy.

occurrences.englishText: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades,
